name: obsidian-nous
description: Nous (Greek for 'mind') turns meeting recordings, voice memos, photos, and PDFs into a tagged, linked knowledge graph, right inside Obsidian - auto-summarized, cross-linked, and organized into wiki pages. Works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, a local model, or your Claude subscription.

scripts.build:recorder:universal: swift build -c release --package-path native/nous-recorder --arch arm64 --arch x86_64
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Andy Ho
